wikidot.preview.open: Start new preview tab for the current wikitext
wikidot.preview.openToSide: Start new preview tab to the side for the current wikitext
wikidot.preview.toggleLock: Toggle lock status of current preview tab
wikidot.preview.toggleLive: Toggle live status of current preview tab
wikidot.preview.lock: Defaults preview to lock to one wikidot document or not
wikidot.preview.live: Defaults preview to be live or not (refresh-on-command), only active when using wikidot backend
wikidot.preview.backend: Default backend for the preview to use (wikidot/wikidot)
wikidot.preview.wikidot: Default site for wikidot preview to base on
